name: N019 paper-structure implementation

paper_commitment.duration_window_loss: MSE on summed duration of each four-unit window
paper_commitment.vocoder_conditioning: frame-wise concatenation of unit embedding and speaker embedding

implementation_choices.hubert_layer_evidence: Reference [26] (Miao et al., Odyssey 2022), which N019 explicitly cites for K=200, states that it extracts 768-D vectors from the output of the sixth Transformer layer and learns 200 k-means clusters on LibriSpeech train-clean-100. Current layer 6 / K=200 / clean-100 fitting matches that source. Reference [32] (Kreuk et al., EMNLP 2022) reports layer 9 with K=200, but N019's K=200 wording points to [26], so layer 9 is a secondary unresolved possibility rather than the primary alignment choice.
implementation_choices.duration_architecture_evidence: DISSC (reference [17]) LenPredictor: 32-D token embedding, seven 128-channel Conv1d+BatchNorm layers, LeakyReLU, linear output
implementation_choices.kmeans_algorithm: MiniBatchKMeans over every available frame in one streaming pass
implementation_choices.kmeans_fit_evidence: Reference [26] explicitly learns 200 k-means clusters on LibriSpeech train-clean-100 and uses the sixth HuBERT Transformer layer.
implementation_choices.vocoder_batch_size_evidence: speech-resynthesis hubert100_lut.json uses batch_size=16; two GPUs correspond to the two separately trained NT/ECAPA vocoders, not per-model DDP
implementation_choices.vocoder_learning_rate_evidence: speech-resynthesis commit dbb92c8ddeb081e711adbe9a75714027cd447532 configs default to 0.0002; the prior 0.0008 was not a paper value. This remains an implementation choice because N019 does not report optimizer hyperparameters.
implementation_choices.vocoder_learning_rate_risk: DISSC commit 4b6160bd3c1733ef01527bf2edaf575788ca60f8, sr/configs/VCTK/hubert100_lut.json uses learning_rate=0.0008, batch_size=64 and num_gpus=2. N019 cites references [27,32], not DISSC [17], for the vocoder, so 0.0002 versus 0.0008 cannot be resolved from public text. Do not describe the current value as author-confirmed.
implementation_choices.vocoder_gradient_clipping_evidence: speech-resynthesis train.py does not clip generator gradients; the prior 5.0 clipping was an undocumented implementation choice
implementation_choices.vocoder_optimizer_evidence: speech-resynthesis commit dbb92c8ddeb081e711adbe9a75714027cd447532 train.py constructs torch.optim.AdamW for both generator and discriminators. The completed checkpoints also use AdamW. Adam remains selectable only for an explicitly labeled diagnostic; it is not the cited upstream default.
implementation_choices.vocoder_checkpoint_selection: offline paired UTMOS/WhiSQA with WER gate
implementation_choices.target_embedding_speaker_mean_ab: mean target speaker embeddings over the selected target pool, then L2-normalise; full-other500 and 32-sample variants were compared on dev-100
implementation_choices.vocoder_architecture_evidence: speech-resynthesis HuBERT unit configuration and DISSC speaker-conditioned Unit HiFi-GAN configuration

current_best_reproduction_variant.status: reproduction enhancement, not all components are paper-confirmed
current_best_reproduction_variant.privacy_metrics_status: E-VPC I/L/S and W-NT I/L/S completed on the formal WAV set; see results/formal
